name: Sun Cleric: Wrath of God already boosts Sunflare/Dawnsear crit and cuts pushback (#1807)
contract: Effect 0 of both ranks is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), MiscValue 7 = SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE, EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 0x102 (bit 1 | bit 8), a single one-mod-two-targets mask: Dawnsear (500146) carries bit 1 (0x2) in its own SpellFamilyFlags word 1, and Sunflare (800231) carries bit 8 (0x100) in its own word 1 -- either bit alone satisfies SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod's generic flag96 AND, so the same modifier reaches both named spells. Rank 1's BasePoints 2 resolves to 3, rank 2's BasePoints 5 resolves to 6, matching 'Increases the critical strike chance of Sunflare and Dawnsear by 3%/6%'. Effect 1 is a plain APPLY_AURA SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK (aura 149, no classMask, a stock generic self-buff): rank 1's BasePoints 49 resolves to 50, rank 2's 99 resolves to 100, matching 'reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 50%/100%'. Native only, no server code needed. The two ranks are separate spell IDs behind the CoA advancement catalog's own entry (CharacterAdvancement.dbc id 6866): AscensionCompat.cpp's SetTalentRank removes every other rank's spell before learning the selected one, so a real character never holds both at once. Three fixtures (control/rank1/rank2), each learning only its own rank via the harness's raw learnSpell path, reproduce that one-rank-at-a-time reality without needing the harness to model rank replacement.
